originLaw: Actual host-held provenance only. Explicit native inputs are externally supplied records, not spawned-provider output. Retained replay preserves original known input origin for admission defects; missing/corrupt custody and signature/schema/identity failures retain their more specific existing laws and precede these semantic guards. A host bug constructing an invalid layer is host-generated; do not call any external malformed input a host bug. Unknown/impossible provenance refuses derivation. No caller origin label.
domainDetailNullMeaning: Registry null means OMIT termination.domainDetail, never emit null. Where native.input-import-invalid is carried, actual DomainDetail object with that code is used. All failure envelopes require actual allocated RequestId, class-derived exit2/4 and exactly one errors detail, matching termination detail if present, otherwise route envelopeDetail with code-keyed remedy and bounded internal diagnostic subject. Internal keys never public codes.
